coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Utah County Government’s official GIS portal advertises its parcel map and nightly-updated Tax Parcel data combining Recorder parcel linework with Assessor detail. The official county `TaxParcels_mobile` MapServer layer 21 (`live_parcel_polygon`, 16K scale product) returned one full polygon at the unchanged WUP point with safe fields only. A separate Provo-hosted detailed polygon layer returned zero at that point and documents redundant condo geometries; therefore the county alternate is a concrete exact-point geometry candidate, but its scale-specific behavior and source consistency require root qualification before runtime.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official county layer 21 schema and one exact WUP polygon are verified; countywide/complete source coverage and runtime contract behavior are not. Separate Provo-hosted detailed layer returned zero at exact point.

technicalBlocker: The Utah County public 4K assessment-map layer returns full point-containing parcel geometry and passes thirteen-cell count/OID manifests, forced small pages and fresh reads of all 157 native parcel IDs. Its complete polygons overlap: independent root EPSG:26912 GEOS audit records 183 pairs above 0.01 m², 787.125 m² aggregate overlap and no invalidity, duplicates or operation errors. The target-footprint proposal binds three parcels instead of one, including a material 9.44 m² intrusion. COGO completeness and an alternate profile transport failure are preserved separately. These are source-model/topology incompatibilities with exclusive parcel ground, not evidence of unavailable cadastre or absent public geometry.
remainingUncertainty: The County TaxParcels layer is a scale-specific assessment/recorder product. Multiple parcel polygons overlap, including a material overlap of PARCELID 350180500 over target 350180070. No legal title, survey accuracy or citywide coverage is established.
nextStep: Root independently audits the new qualification and topology evidence. Do not enable source for proposals until multi-ID binding and overlap topology are resolved.
pointBasis: Exact unchanged UN WUP 2025 city point (latitude, longitude); not an administrative boundary or a cadastral result.
registryBasis: Utah County Government identifies its GIS Division as serving the county and publishes the Tax Parcel dataset, refreshed nightly and combining Recorder parcel linework with Assessor detail. The official local-authority map-service layer is county-wide and includes Provo; one exact-WUP-point polygon was verified. This is a public parcel source, but the map-service layer is a 16K-scale product and does not alone establish a production-ready feed.
